blocks.text: Maslon ko is base par bhi baanta ja sakta hai ke woh kitne saaf (clearly) bayan kiye gaye hain:

items: Well-defined Problems (saaf masle): in ke goal (maqsad), inputs, process aur outputs saaf hote hain. Misal: yeh maloom karna ke koi number even (juft) hai ya nahi. Goal saaf hai (number even hai ya nahi), input saaf hai (ek integer), process saaf hai (dekhna ke number 2 se poora divide hota hai ya nahi) aur output saaf hai (even ya odd), jaisa Figure 3.1 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

Ill-defined Problems (gol mol masle): in ki tareef saaf nahi hoti, ya in ke goals aur requirements (zaroorat) ambiguous (gol mol) hoti hain. Misal: “Pakistan mein taleem behtar karna” ka project. Yeh goal gol mol aur bohat broad (khula, bara) hai. Input mein funding, teachers aur taleemi materials (kitabein waghera) ho sakte hain, magar yeh saaf nahi ke kitni funding chahiye, kaise teachers chahiyein, ya kaunse materials sab se zyada faida dega.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Students apne shehar ka naqsha (map) banayenge jis mein kai colleges hon, aur is se route optimization (sab se behtar raasta chunna) seekhenge. Har student naqshe par kam az kam paanch colleges lagaye aur un ke darmiyan faasle (distances) likhe. Maqsad: aisa sab se chhota raasta banana jo har college par theek ek dafa jaye aur wapas shuru wali jagah par aaye.

blocks.alt: Flowchart: Start; Write "Enter an integer"; Read x; heere ki shakal (diamond) mein x MOD 2 == 0. False baen taraf Write "Odd" tak, True daen taraf Write "Even" tak; dono lakeerein mil kar End tak jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.1: Even number ki pehchan (kitab ki Figure 3.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Parallelogram (tircha dabba) input ya output hai: Write screen par likhta hai aur Read x user se number leta hai. Diamond sawal poochta hai: x MOD 2 yani x ko 2 se divide karne par baqi (remainder). Baqi 0 ho to True, number even hai; warna False, number odd hai. Python mein yahi shart x % 2 == 0 likhi jati hai.
Yeh program Figure 3.1 wala kaam karta hai: x ko 2 se divide kar ke remainder (baqi) dekhta hai. x ki value badal kar Run karein aur dekhein jawab Even se Odd kaise badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: paanch colleges aur un ke faasle maloom hon to har college par ek dafa ja kar wapas aane ka sab se chhota raasta kaise dhoondenge?
blocks.explanation: Shuru wala college tay kar lein; baqi chaar colleges 4 x 3 x 2 x 1 = 24 tarteebon (orders) mein ja sakte hain (agar ulta chakkar alag na ginein to 12). Har tarteeb ke faasle jama karein aur sab se chhota chun lein. Yeh Travelling Salesman Problem hai; colleges barhne par is tareeqe se hal karna taqreeban na-mumkin ho jata hai (topic 3.3.2).

blocks.prompt: Well-defined problem ki characteristics (khoobiyan) kya hai (MCQ 1)? Well-defined aur ill-defined problems mein farq bataiye (short question 1).
blocks.explanation: (c) Clear goals, inputs, processes and outputs. Well-defined masla theek theek batata hai ke kya diya gaya hai, kya karna hai aur kya nateeja chahiye, is liye us ka algorithm likha ja sakta hai. Ill-defined masle ka goal gol mol ya requirements adhoori hoti hain, is liye pehle use saaf (well-defined) banana parta hai.

items: Well-defined: saaf goal, input, process, output (even ya odd).
Ill-defined: gol mol goal ('taleem behtar karna'); pehle use saaf karna hoga.
